ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for more training crawlers (Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, meta-externalagent, anthropic-ai, cohere-ai)
ideas.why: geo.config.json blocks training crawlers but robots.txt only names GPTBot and ClaudeBot, so the policy is only partly enforced.

ideas.idea: Add explicit allow groups for AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, Applebot) that repeat Disallow: /account
ideas.why: They are already allowed through the * group, so explicit groups change little and add maintenance.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD (Organization/LocalBusiness, Place with opening hours, BreadcrumbList)
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add address, map, parking and phone details to the visit page, since the description promises directions
ideas.why: The visit page lacks the directions its own description promises, and concrete facts help people and answer engines.

ideas.idea: List the varieties on the varieties page with per-variety details, since it claims over forty but shows two
ideas.why: This matches the actual page, which names only two varieties, and gives real content to find and quote.

ideas.idea: Expand the home page with what is sold, how to buy, and the location
ideas.why: It is accurate, but it is mostly a 'thin page' complaint, which is not a problem here.

ideas.idea: Add site-wide metadata defaults (title.template, default title and description) in the layout
ideas.why: Every page already sets its own title and description, so a template has very little effect.

ideas.idea: Add openGraph and twitter card metadata, including an image
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site and mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Resolve the /account conflict between robots.txt Disallow and noindex by dropping the Disallow
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say noindex plus Disallow on /account is correct, and the report itself rates the risk as low.

ideas.idea: Add a description to the /account page
ideas.why: It is a private noindex page, so a description has no value.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap and generate it with app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: This is accurate, but with three static URLs the effect is small.

ideas.idea: Use next/link instead of plain <a> tags in the nav
ideas.why: It improves navigation speed, but crawlers follow plain links fine, so it does little for discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add aria-label to the nav and wrap the page in header/footer landmarks
ideas.why: This is minor accessibility and semantics advice that applies to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Add 'Herefordshire' to the home page title
ideas.why: The title omits the location, which the description and content do mention, so this helps with local relevance.

ideas.idea: Don't spread data-nosnippet to real content
ideas.why: The report itself calls the current use fine, and the caution is generic.

ideas.idea: Add llms.txt as an optional extra
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no llms.txt is not a problem, and it is folklore as a way to be found.
